metadata.description: Skills and hooks from my AI coding setup. Pick the ones you want.

plugins.name: github-issue
plugins.description: Write GitHub issues as Why / What / Acceptance criteria, split big work into sub-issues

plugins.name: pull-request
plugins.description: PR descriptions in plain language with before/after screenshots and a walkthrough video for new features and significant UI changes

plugins.name: pr-screenshots
plugins.description: Upload screenshots to a PR body as GitHub attachments, never committed

plugins.name: pr-review-fix
plugins.description: Work through every review comment on a PR

plugins.name: ux-review
plugins.description: Walk a running web app and produce an HTML page of UX suggestions to approve or decline

plugins.name: ui-review
plugins.description: Review a running web app's visual design and consistency, including AI slop, as an HTML page to approve or decline

plugins.name: dev-hooks
plugins.description: Format each edit with the project's own Biome; warn when dev-server ports are still open at the end of a turn
